module: Flowgraph node 'Set Stage Lights' (repeat_instant category). Turns on the Pre Stage or Stage light of the drag race Christmas tree (scene objects Prestagelight_l/r and Stagelight_l/r) on side 'side' ('l' or 'r', default 'l'). 'light' is 'preStage' (default) or 'stage'. The 'reset' impulse hides all these lights.
notes: The flow output is never written, and the flow input pin is not tested.
Without a prior reset, self.lights is empty and work crashes when accessing the lights.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

postInit.desc: Defines the offered values of the pins side (left/right) and light (Pre Stage/Stage).

initLights.desc: Searches the scene for the four light objects.

work.desc: On reset: finds the lights again and hides them. Otherwise makes the chosen light visible.
